answer: Proof of Compute serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend verifiable energy to prove identity. Unlike a digital garden where identities proliferate cheaply, each new identity requires hardware overhead that forces an attacker to wander through costly compute cycles. A single rogue sparrow node cannot replicate its influence without significant capital, as the protocol ties voting weight directly to the verifiable energy cost, rendering mass identity fabrication economically irrational.
